تستقبلوا (form X)
# تَسْتَقْبِلُوا (tastaqbilū) /tas.taq.bi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْبَلَ (istaqbala)
# تُسْتَقْبَلُوا (tustaqbalū) /tus.taq.ba.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْبَلَ (istaqbala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
